mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a completed four-hour canonical ALMA slope sign turn identifies a smooth low-lag trend rotation; follow the new slope for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when ALMA slope turns strictly positive; short when it turns strictly negative
mechanism.why_distinct: ALMA applies a fixed offset Gaussian kernel over nine completed closes, concentrating weight near the recent end without recursive smoothing or linearly weighted Hull differencing. It is not a price-level crossover, return sum, regression, range path, prior candidate repair, volume, flow, OI, funding, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse Gaussian low-lag slope turns are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T)
features.alma: normalized Gaussian-weighted average of nine continuous completed closes
features.slope: current ALMA minus immediately prior ALMA
features.event: current finite nonzero slope sign differs from immediately prior finite nonzero slope sign
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed one-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical ALMA(9,0.85,6) slope turn under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no window, offset, sigma, slope, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, control, or other repair.

external_basis.origin: Arnaud Legoux and Dimitrios Douzis-Loukas canonical ALMA convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: window 9, offset 0.85, sigma 6; m=offset*(window-1), s=window/sigma, weight_i=exp(-(i-m)^2/(2*s^2)), normalized over oldest i=0 through newest i=8
external_basis.selection_use: published defaults, Gaussian construction, and slope direction only; no incidence or outcomes
